summary: Iteration 40 — end-to-end backend + UI checks of the four new features (member profile, web-app settings, client invites, bookings, before/after compare) plus the cross-tenant isolation regression. Backend pytest: 24/24 pass in test_iter40_profile_bookings_invite_compare.py. UI smoke: member gate + My account panel + Bookings tab in /site-admin all work; /compare/{code} renders with NO auth, no horizontal overflow at 390px, and the lead form submits (compare-lead-sent shown).

issues: Login form inputs and submit have no data-testid (member-login-email / member-login-password / member-login-submit not present). Not blocking but forces tests to fall back to input[type=email] / input[type=password] selectors.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid attributes to the MemberGate sign-in form fields (email, password, submit button) for durable UI tests.

(Optional) Consider exposing data-testid=client-invite-card / client-invite-email / client-invite-btn on the App Detail (Overview) page — I verified the API path (POST /apps/{id}/webapp/invite-client, list, revoke, /site/{token}/invite/{code}, /accept) but did not visually confirm the invite card render location. UI counterpart wasn't reached because /site-admin does not host it — it's in /apps/{appId}.
critical_code_review_comments: compare.py L58: `code = existing['code'] if existing else secrets.token_urlsafe(9)` — good, idempotent per tenant. Verified.
compare.py L53-54: 'not before and not body.before_image' raises 400. When a body has neither before_url nor before_image and preview_token exists → 400. Verified on a throwaway app.
site_app.py me_delete (L607): correctly gated on allow_self_delete. Deletion nulls submissions.site_user_id (soft) — good, keeps analytics intact.
site_app.py invite_client L696: previous invites for same email flipped to 'revoked' before writing the new one — good idempotency.

site_app.py accept_invite L740: idempotency is not enforced against 'accepted' state; a used code is caught because state != 'sent'. However there is no explicit test that a REVOKED code returns 400 — the state check does that implicitly. Verified: second /accept with used code returns 400.

site_app.py open_slots L628: fixed-mode slot generation uses <= end, so a 09-17 window with step 30 yields 09:00..16:30 (last slot fully inside window). Correct; the taken-list filter uses booking.slot equality against period names in period mode which will never intersect — fine because period mode short-circuits before that path.
site_app.py admin_booking_action L646-672: reschedule requires body.date, decline is idempotent, unknown action → 400, member role gets 403 through require_panel — all four verified in tests.

site_app.py L613: submissions.update_many after self-delete nulls out site_user_id — this correctly hides the deleted user's submissions from /me/submissions of any future account with the same email. Good.

Public routes (/api/public/compare/{code} + /lead) do NOT require auth and do NOT touch get_current_user — verified with a completely bare requests session (no cookies): 200 on public GET, 200 on lead POST, message row appears in tenant inbox.
Tenant SITE_AUD JWT is correctly rejected on agency endpoints: member1 bearer token → 401 on /api/apps/{id}/webapp, /compare-link, /apps list. Verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the exercised flows (compare page mobile+lead, member gate → My account edit+save, admin panel 5 tabs, Bookings tab actions rendered)
